What To Expect
Overview
Step inside a living 4-story rainforest, where dripping water sets the beat for a symphony of croaking frogs and chirping birds.
Meet chameleons from Madagascar, climb into the treetops of Costa Rica to find free flying birds and butterflies.
Finally, descend in a glass elevator into the Amazonian flooded forest, where an acrylic tunnel allows you to walk beneath the catfish and arapaima that swim overhead.
Come nose-to-beak with an African penguin, watch sharks and stingrays cruise beneath your feet and check out the set of teeth on a piranha.
